lead: Jan van Kessel the Elder or Jan van Kessel (baptized 5 April 1626 – 17 April 1679) was a Flemish painter active in Antwerp in the mid-17th century.
paras: A versatile artist, he practiced in many genres including studies of insects, floral still lifes, marines, river landscapes, paradise landscapes, allegorical compositions, scenes with animals and genre scenes.
